description: This file defines the ResponsiveImageStyleForm class, a Drupal form controller for creating and editing responsive image styles, including breakpoint and image style mappings.

classes.name: ResponsiveImageStyleForm
classes.description: A Drupal form controller for creating and editing responsive image styles, managing breakpoint groups, image style mappings, and form validation.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Static method to instantiate the form with the breakpoint manager from the container.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the breakpoint manager dependency.

methods.name: form
methods.description: Builds the responsive image style form, including breakpoint group selection, image style mappings, and fallback style.

methods.name: breakpointMappingFormAjax
methods.description: AJAX callback to update the breakpoint-to-image style mappings form section.

methods.name: validateForm
methods.description: Validates the form, ensuring at least one image style is selected for sizes mappings and sizes attribute is provided.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Saves the responsive image style entity with updated mappings and redirects accordingly.
